message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions to help introduce a new teacher to your 生徒. Ask these questions before the big reveal to really build some excitement and anticipation in the 教室.

**1.** The new teacher has a secret hobby that involves animals in some surprising or unexpected 不思議. True or false?

**2.** The teacher can speak more than two different languages fluently and one 言語 that most people would not expect a teacher to know. True or false?

**3.** The teacher 先生 has visited more than ten different countries during their life travels around the world. True or 嘘.

**4.** The teacher used to perform in a band or play music very professionally in their 過去. True or false?

**5.** The teacher has a very specific favorite food that most of the 学生 would never guess correctly. True or false?

**6.** The teacher is actually afraid of something completely 恐怖 to most people. True or false?

That should get the students really excited and full of 期待 for the big reveal!
